description: Walk a full kill chain end-to-end against the infrastructure graph. Given a natural-language scenario or 'what if' query, returns verdict + severity + every stage of the attack (entry → pivot → impact) + blast radius + follow-up moves. Read-only — no AWS changes.

query.description: Natural-language query about the infra. Examples: 'what gets exposed if SG_001 opens port 80', 'show the worst attack path'. Tokens like SG_001 are auto-expanded.
